chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from one of his companions, from Ibn Abi Najran, from one of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

A Christian man sneezed in the presence of Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him). So the people said to him, 'May Allah guide you.' So Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said, 'You should say, May Allah have mercy on you.' They said to him, 'He is a Christian.' So he (peace be upon him) said, 'Allah will not guide him until He has mercy on him.'

key_terms.يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ: May Allah have mercy on you

ai.seo_question: What is the correct response to a Christian's sneeze according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes a nuanced etiquette where the response to a non-Muslim's sneeze is 'May Allah have mercy on you' rather than 'May Allah guide you,' reflecting the Shia scholarly view that mercy is a universal attribute of God while guidance is contingent upon faith. This distinction highlights the theological principle that divine mercy precedes and facilitates guidance, a concept deeply rooted in Shia exegesis of the relationship between Rahmah and Hidayah. The hadith thus serves as both a social guideline for interfaith interaction and a theological statement on the nature of divine attributes.

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from one of his companions, from Ibn Abu Najran, from one of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘A Christian man sneezed in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>. So the people said to him, ‘May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Guide you’. So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘You should be saying, ‘May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> have Mercy on you’’. So they said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘He is a Christian’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> will not Guide him until He<sup>azwj</sup> has Mercy on him’.
en.sarwar: 18. Abu Ali al-Ash’ari has narrated from certain individuals of his people from ibn abu Najran from certain individuals of our people from abu ‘ Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

Once a Christian man sneezed in the presence of abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) and the people said, ‘May Allah guide you.’ Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) said, ‘Say, “May Allah grant you mercy.’” They said, ‘He is a Christian.’ The Imam said, ‘Allah will not guide him until He grants him mercy.’”
